name: context-pit-crew
description: Context Pit Crew: a Claude Code mod for long sessions. See context and usage limits at a glance, and compact or hand off to a fresh session at a moment Claude has checked.

plugins.name: context-pit-crew
plugins.description: Helps you run long Claude Code sessions with less lost to compaction: shows context, the 5-hour and weekly limits, an estimate of prompt-cache warmth and the API-equivalent cost above the prompt, has Claude check for a safe spot before the compactions it starts, and hands off to a fresh session with a short brief.
